definitions.gloss: rushing about busily; running around in all directions
definitions.explanation: To run about busily from place to place trying to get things done. A four-character idiom (yojijukugo) expressing energetic but hectic activity.

examples.japanese: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧だ。
examples.english: Every day is spent rushing about.

examples.japanese: {資金集|しきんあつ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ran around everywhere to raise funds.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てた→疲れ果てる：17963_tsukarehateru⟧。
examples.english: I was completely exhausted from rushing around preparing for the event.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) meaning to rush about in all directions. Literally: ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧ (east) + {奔|ほん} (run) + ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west) + {走|そう} (run) — "running east and running west."

USAGE:
Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Implies being extremely busy going from place to place to handle various matters. Often used for work-related hustle, fundraising, or event preparation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧: days spent rushing about
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rush around for ~
- {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: to be tired from rushing about

REGISTER:
Fairly literary/formal. More vivid and emphatic than simply saying ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ (busy). Often appears in written narratives and formal speech.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{奔走|ほんそう}する→奔走する：25550_honsousuru⟧: to run about, to make efforts (two-character version, more common)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧: to run around (everyday equivalent)
